# Data-quality record (generated by eda/run_eda.py)

- Trips: train=80, student_test=10. Evaluator-test trips are not in this package.
- GPS observations: train=208,417; NaN values: 0; non-increasing timestamps: 0.
- Missing files: student_test/00000000 .arcs -> trip cannot be map-matched; excluded.
- Sampling: 96.5% of steps are 1 s. Trips with a gap > 10 min: 00000011, 00000021, 00000042, 00000069, 00000078, 00000090.
- Each trip ships its own local road network; trips are spread worldwide, so distances use a per-trip local equirectangular projection in metres (error < 1 % at trip scale).
- The .route file is an ordered arc list, not one label per GPS row. Per-point labels come from a monotone DP alignment of GPS points to route arcs (features/labels.py).
- Points more than 100 m from their aligned reference arc are flagged unreliable (9.9% of train points); they are excluded from training and from accuracy metrics. Trips with > 20 % unreliable: 00000033, 00000054.
- Example: trip 00000054's reference route ends after ~27 min while GPS continues for ~4.5 h away from the network, so the reference route does not cover the whole trajectory.
- Reference routes are not always connected: 11 trips have consecutive route arcs that do not share a node -> treat the reference as approximate.
- Two-way streets appear as two arcs with identical geometry and opposite direction; only the travel direction (heading feature) separates them.
